SCN_T|/note: Drilling pattern according to the SCHOMBURG system “Crack repair (wall surfaces)”: holes at 20 cm intervals, offset, at an angle of 45° to the crack. What is specific to a scenario follows general injection practice; hole diameter, packer type and spacing according to the project specification.
STEP_P1|/short: Where water flows: AQUAFIN-P1 first. It foams on contact with water and stops the ingress.
STEP_P1|/overview: Where the {defect} conducts water, an initial injection of {P1} is necessary to stop the ingress of water. {P1} reacts with water to a watertight, visco-plastic foam.
STEP_P1|/points/0: {P1}: foaming polyurethane injection resin for the temporary sealing of water-conducting cracks
STEP_P1|/points/1: foams to up to 40 times its volume on contact with water
STEP_P1|/points/2: remove excess foam flush with the surface once it has reacted
STEP_P1|/points/3: an additional injection of {P4} is then necessary: it gives the permanent, elastic, crack-bridging seal
STEP_P1|/note: Sequence on this page: once the water has stopped, the surface is sealed with {EKF}, then {P4} is injected.
STEP_P1|/src: Sources: SCHOMBURG technical data sheet AQUAFIN-P4, 20/05/2026; product page AQUAFIN-P1; system “Crack repair (wall surfaces)”.
SCN_PROC.wall|/drill/extra/0: Holes every 20 cm, offset to alternate sides of the crack, at an angle of 45°: each hole crosses the crack inside the wall (SCHOMBURG system “Crack repair (wall surfaces)”).
SCN_PROC.wall|/drill/extra/1: Locate the reinforcement first and drill between the bars.
SCN_PROC.wall|/inject/extra/0: Vertical cracks: start at the lowest packer and work upwards.
SCN_PROC.wall|/inject/extra/1: Change to the next packer when resin emerges there.
SCN_PROC.hjoint|/drill/extra/0: Packers alternately above and below the joint; every hole meets the joint at 45° inside the wall.
SCN_PROC.hjoint|/drill/extra/1: Locate the reinforcement first and drill between the bars.
SCN_PROC.hjoint|/inject/extra/0: Work along the joint packer by packer, starting at one end.
SCN_PROC.hjoint|/inject/extra/1: Resin emerging at the next packer shows that the section between the two is filled.
SCN_PROC.wfjoint|/drill/extra/0: Drill from the wall face at 45° downwards, so that the hole meets the joint under the wall.
SCN_PROC.wfjoint|/drill/extra/1: Keep clear of the starter bars that cross the joint.
SCN_PROC.wfjoint|/seal/extra/0: Seal the joint in the corner between wall and floor with {EKF}, together with the packers.
SCN_PROC.wfjoint|/inject/extra/0: The resin spreads along the joint: inject until it emerges at the neighbouring packer.
SCN_PROC.wfjoint|/inject/extra/1: New construction: the injection hose {CJ1} is cast into this joint and injected with {P1} or {P4}.
SCN_PROC.honeycomb|/drill/extra/0: Drill at 45° into the gravel pocket; distribute the holes over its whole area.
SCN_PROC.honeycomb|/drill/extra/1: Sound the surface first: the pocket is often larger than the visible defect.
SCN_PROC.honeycomb|/seal/extra/0: Close the open surface of the pocket with {EKF}; otherwise the low-viscosity resin runs out.
SCN_PROC.honeycomb|/inject/extra/0: Inject from the lowest packer upwards until the space between the grains is filled.
SCN_PROC.honeycomb|/inject/extra/1: Consumption follows the volume of voids: approx. 1.1 kg per litre (technical data sheet).
SCN_PROC.pipe|/drill/extra/0: Set the holes around the pipe and drill at 45° towards the ring joint.
SCN_PROC.pipe|/drill/extra/1: Do not drill into the pipe or its sleeve.
SCN_PROC.pipe|/seal/extra/0: Seal the ring joint all around the pipe with {EKF}.
SCN_PROC.pipe|/inject/extra/0: Work around the pipe packer by packer until the resin emerges at the next packer.
SCN_PROC.pipe|/inject/extra/1: {P4} adheres to both flanks and cures to soft elastic.
SCN_PROC.slab|/drill/extra/0: Drill from the top, at 45°, on alternating sides of the crack.
SCN_PROC.slab|/drill/extra/1: Check for services and reinforcement in the slab before drilling.
SCN_PROC.slab|/inject/extra/0: Work along the crack from one end; change packer when resin emerges at the next one.
SCN_PROC.dam|/drill/extra/0: All work is done from the dry side.
SCN_PROC.dam|/drill/extra/1: Holes at 45° on alternating sides: they cross the crack inside the wall.
SCN_PROC.dam|/p1/extra/0: Water under pressure: inject {P1} until the water stops at the surface.
SCN_PROC.dam|/inject/extra/0: {P4} follows as the permanent, elastic, crack-bridging seal.
SCN_PROC.sewer|/drill/extra/0: Injection from inside the sewer; keep the flow away from the working zone.
SCN_PROC.sewer|/drill/extra/1: Holes at 45° on alternating sides of the crack.
SCN_PROC.sewer|/p1/extra/0: Infiltrating ground water: {P1} first, until the inflow stops.
SCN_PROC.sewer|/inject/extra/0: {P4} follows for the permanent, elastic waterproofing of the crack.
SCN_PROC.manhole|/drill/extra/0: Divert the flow and pump the chamber down before work starts; ventilate and monitor the atmosphere.
SCN_PROC.manhole|/drill/extra/1: Holes at 45° alternately above and below the joint between the lifts, so that each crosses the joint inside the wall.
SCN_PROC.manhole|/p1/extra/0: Infiltrating ground water: {P1} first, until the inflow stops.
SCN_PROC.manhole|/inject/extra/0: {P4} follows along the joint packer by packer for the permanent, elastic seal.
SCN_PROC.cutcover|/drill/extra/0: Work from inside the tunnel in a lane closure; keep the walkway clear.
SCN_PROC.cutcover|/drill/extra/1: Holes drilled from the wall face at 45° downwards, so that they cross the wall–base joint under the wall.
SCN_PROC.cutcover|/p1/extra/0: Ground water running along the joint: {P1} first, until the joint is dry at the surface.
SCN_PROC.cutcover|/inject/extra/0: {P4} spreads along the joint from packer to packer; resin at the next packer shows the section is filled.
SCN_PROC.tbm|/drill/extra/0: Locate the bolt pockets and the gasket groove first; drill between them, never into the gasket or a bolt.
SCN_PROC.tbm|/drill/extra/1: Holes at 45° to the joint on alternating sides, ending at the joint plane inside the segment.
SCN_PROC.tbm|/p1/extra/0: Water through the ring joint: {P1} first, until the inflow stops.
SCN_PROC.tbm|/inject/extra/0: {P4} seals the joint elastically; low pressure, so that the resin fills the joint without lifting the segment.
SCN_PROC.shield|/drill/extra/0: Outside operating hours, from the walkway; the track and the cables protected.
SCN_PROC.shield|/drill/extra/1: Holes at 45° to the joint on alternating sides, clear of the bolts and the gasket groove.
SCN_PROC.shield|/p1/extra/0: High ground water: {P1} first, until the inflow at the joint stops.
SCN_PROC.shield|/inject/extra/0: {P4} follows for the permanent, elastic seal of the joint; pressures kept low.
SCN_PROC.immersed|/drill/extra/0: The Gina gasket and the Omega seal are never drilled: the holes go into the concrete of the element beside the joint.
SCN_PROC.immersed|/drill/extra/1: Holes at 45° on alternating sides of the crack, so that each crosses it inside the wall.
SCN_PROC.immersed|/p1/extra/0: Water under the head above: {P1} first, until the inflow stops.
SCN_PROC.immersed|/inject/extra/0: {P4} follows as the elastic, watertight seal of the crack.
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/drill/points/0: no drilling: thin components, dense reinforcement or prestressing steel stay untouched
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/drill/points/1: remove loose parts, dust and laitance along the crack
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/packers/points/0: adhesive packers bonded centrally over the crack with {EKF}
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/packers/points/1: the crack must stay open under each packer
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/packers/points/2: packer spacing according to the project specification
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/seal/points/0: seal the crack between and around the packers with {EKF}
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/seal/points/1: allow the crack insulation to cure before grouting
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/inject/extra/0: Low pressure: the bond of the adhesive packers limits the injection pressure.
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/inject/extra/1: For a force-locking bond of dry cracks in concrete: {IH} — not for statically relevant areas.
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/plug/points/1: the surface seal can be removed as necessary for visual reasons
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/callouts/1/1: Adhesive packers are bonded over the crack with {EKF}; nothing is drilled. In X-ray view the reinforcement stays untouched. Stage “Surface sealed” shows the seal between the packers.
SCN_PROC.adhesive|/callouts/2/1: Stage “Sealed”: the crack is filled with the resin and the adhesive packers are removed. The surface dries.
SCN_UI|/tlSub: {n} steps for this scenario. The steps follow the technical data sheet; select a step for the details.
SCN_UI|/practice: Drilling pattern: SCHOMBURG system “Crack repair (wall surfaces)”. The other scenario notes follow general injection practice; the project specification decides.
SCN_UI|/practiceGlued: The notes for adhesive packers follow general injection practice; the project specification decides.
SCN_UI|/p1how/1: Where the {defect} conducts water, {P1} is injected first. It reacts with the water to a watertight foam; excess foam is removed flush.
SIMT|/brief_eyebrow: Operation briefing · Basement wall, axis C
SIMT|/brief_sub: A crack runs through the full height of the reinforced concrete wall; the surface is damp, the crack is not water-conducting. AQUAFIN-P4 can be used on dry and damp substrates. Run the complete sequence from the technical data sheet and finish the injection within the pot life of approx. 30 minutes.
SIMT|/brief/0: Survey the crack and mark five injection points
SIMT|/brief/2: Clear the holes with oil-free compressed air
SIMT|/brief/4: Seal packers and crack zone approx. 15 cm wide with ASODUR-EKF
SIMT|/brief/5: Mix 1 : 1 by volume and grout in AQUAFIN-P4
SIMT|/brief/6: Remove the packers and plug the boreholes with ASOCRET-M30
SIMT|/keys/1/1: drill, blow out, seal, grout, plug
SIMT|/phases/0/p: Select the marker and mark the five injection points along the crack.
SIMT|/phases/1/p: Select the drill. Hold on each mark until the hole reaches its depth. The view into the wall shows the hole passing between the reinforcing bars.
SIMT|/phases/2/p: Select the compressed air. Hold on each hole to clear the drilling debris. Oil-free air only.
SIMT|/phases/3/p: Select the packer and insert one injection packer into each hole.
SIMT|/phases/4/p: Select ASODUR-EKF. Seal packers and crack zone approx. 15 cm wide, working from the bottom upwards.
SIMT|/phases/5/p: Mix the resin, then select the injection pump. Grout in from the lowest packer upwards.
SIMT|/phases/6/p: Select the packer tool and remove the packers. Then plug each borehole flush with ASOCRET-M30.
SIMT|/done/4: Surface sealed. The crack insulation cures.
SIMT|/done/6: Boreholes plugged flush with the surface.
SIMT|/lapse2: The resin cures. Final curing at 20 °C: approx. 5 hours …
SIMT|/mix/0: Add the hardener to the resin. The hardener must run completely out of the container.
SIMT|/mix/1: Mix thoroughly, approx. 3 minutes at approx. 300 rpm.
SIMT|/mix/2: Decant the mass into a clean bucket and stir carefully again.
SIMT|/mix_go: The pot life runs: approx. 30 minutes.
SIMT|/potOut: Pot life exceeded. Mix a fresh batch.
SIMT|/res_title: Crack sealed. The resin cures to soft elastic.
SIMT|/res_sub: Clean the tools immediately with suitable solvent; the cleaning agent must have a flash point above +21 °C. Observe applicable safety data sheet!
SIMT|/no3d: The simulator needs WebGL and an internet connection to load the 3D library.

QT|/notes/1: In the event of water-conducting cracks, an initial injection of AQUAFIN-P1 is necessary to stop the ingress of water. Not included.
QT|/notes/2: Substrate: concrete min. C20/25, tensile adhesion strength ≥ 1.5 N/mm², age min. 28 days. Substrate temperature approx. 5–30 °C, application temperature approx. 10–30 °C.
